_doc: BASELINE configuration for VortexFlow.Api. This file is SAFE to commit.
It MUST NOT contain real secrets. The shape is preserved so that binding
and DI registration in Program.cs / AddVortexFlowConfiguration() keep working.
All sensitive values are resolved at runtime from, in order of precedence:
On startup, Program.cs runs ValidateCriticalConfiguration() which throws
InvalidOperationException with a clear message if any required secret is
missing, empty, or still a known placeholder.

ConnectionStrings._doc: Injected from env: ConnectionStrings__Postgres / __Redis / __RabbitMq. Empty by design here.

Jwt._doc: Injected from env: Jwt__Secret, Jwt__ValidAudience, Jwt__ValidIssuer. Secret is empty by design here.

ApiKeys._doc: Injected from env: ApiKeys__Internal. Empty by design here.

Bootstrap._doc: Admin seeding is opt-in. AdminEmail/AdminPassword come from env (Bootstrap__AdminEmail, Bootstrap__AdminPassword) and are NEVER committed.
